hypothesis.rationale: shipping is a single-replica service with no PDB or probes (static prediction: kill = total outage) and is called synchronously by orders with a 5s Future.get timeout (SOCK-orders->shipping contract: explicit_timeout, loss_bounded=true). CPU pressure on shipping will degrade the /orders POST path, and while the timeout bounds the hang, it converts the degradation into a 500 after 5s, directly failing the golden journey order submission. This tests resource pressure at a data-dependency position, and the single-replica no-PDB availability amplifies impact.

carts is a single-replica service with no PDB (static prediction: kill = total outage) and is called synchronously by front-end with no timeout (SOCK-frontend->carts contract: no_timeout, loss_bounded=false). Memory pressure on carts will cause OOMKill or severe slowdown, and since front-end has no timeout on this call, any degradation directly hangs user-facing /cart requests. This tests the uncovered action_or_target=memory motif at a business-service position, and the no-timeout contract amplifies impact. The intensity_bucket=unknown is chosen to explore the uncovered motif while keeping the injection realistic for a memory stress test.
